Name: Rabbits Have Babies
Author: ncarigon
Description:
Rabbits in the real world are known for having lots of babies, but rabbits in Stardew Valley are infertile. This mod changes that by:

[list]
[*]Allowing Coop pregnancies
[*]Allowing rabbit pregnancies
[*]Adding a second chance for rabbits to become pregnant
[/list]
This mod uses existing game data and logic to implement these features so it should be highly compatible with other mods, but no specific mods were tested.

Source: [url=https://github.com/ncarigon/StardewValleyMods]ncarigon/StardewValleyMods (github.com)[/url]
